svg.title: ROS 2 node graph — panels
svg.desc: Generated by Scripts/diagrams/node_graph_map.py from the System Node Graph (Docs/flowcharts/ros2_nodes_flowchart.md); layout ELK layered per panel.
svg.text: 77 ROS 2 nodes · 135 topics · 428 links in 22 panels of JetOwl_FlightControl, JetOwl_Vision and Isaac_ROS-Jetbot_NanoOWL · data flows left → right · closed loops in red
Each numbered panel is drawn alone in the files next to this one (NN_*.svg) and all together in Docs/images/ros2_node_graph.svg
